200.body: In November, at least 1,500 military personnel from the United Kingdom, France, Germany, and Poland will arrive in Poland. They will practice a scenario involving the deployment of European forces in Ukraine following a possible ceasefire, according to The Times. British Defense Minister Wes Streeting confirms that next month, thousands of troops will take part in large-scale exercises in Poland. At the same time, this involves rehearsing a possible scenario in the event of a ceasefire, rather than a confirmed decision to immediately deploy troops to Ukraine.

400.title: Europe’s green hydrogen costs could fall sharply with lower electricity grid charges, says Hydrogen Europe
400.summary: Home English Europe’s green hydrogen costs could fall sharply with lower electricity grid charges,...
400.body: Home English Europe’s green hydrogen costs could fall sharply with lower electricity grid charges,... English Green Hydrogen Europe’s green hydrogen costs could fall sharply with lower electricity grid charges, says Hydrogen Europe By Jose Kottanani October 16, 2026 AI Representational Image Europe’s green hydrogen production costs could be significantly reduced by lowering electricity grid charges, taxes and levies imposed on electrolyser operators, reported Gas World, citing Hydrogen Europe. The report, Clean H2 Monitor, found that electricity-related charges vary considerably across European Union member states, adding as much as 5.30 euro per kg to hydrogen production costs in some countries. Industry groups have warned that the proposed changes could increase hydrogen production costs by 1.50 euro to 3 euro per kg.
